source.text: Σὺ οὖν, τέκνον μου, ἐνδυναμοῦ ἐν τῇ χάριτι τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ἃ ἤκουσας παρ’ ἐμοῦ διὰ πολλῶν μαρτύρων, ταῦτα παράθου πιστοῖς ἀνθρώποις, οἵτινες ἱκανοὶ ἔσονται καὶ ἑτέρους διδάξαι.

records.literal_gloss: You therefore, child of me, be strengthened in the grace the [one] in Christ Jesus, \v 2 and what you heard from me through many witnesses, these entrust to faithful men, who able will be also others to teach.

en.L: You then, my child, be strengthened by the grace that is in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus, \v 2 and what you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses, entrust these things to faithful {{gender:people|men}}, who will be able to teach others also.
en.B: So you, my son, be strong in the grace that is in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. \v 2 And what you heard from me before many witnesses, pass on to trustworthy people who will be able to teach others as well.
en.R: So, my son, let the grace of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus make you strong. \v 2 You heard my teaching, and many other people heard it too. Now teach it to people you can trust, people who will be able to teach others.

fr.L: Toi donc, mon enfant, fortifie-toi dans la grâce qui est {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus, \v 2 et ce que tu as entendu de moi en présence de nombreux témoins, confie-le à des {{gender:personnes|hommes}} fidèles, qui seront capables d’enseigner aussi les autres.
fr.B: Toi donc, mon fils, sois fort par la grâce qui est {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus. \v 2 Et ce que tu as entendu de moi devant de nombreux témoins, transmets-le à des personnes dignes de confiance, qui seront capables d’enseigner les autres à leur tour.
fr.R: Alors, mon fils, laisse la grâce du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus te rendre fort. \v 2 Tu as entendu mon enseignement, et beaucoup d’autres l’ont entendu aussi. Maintenant, enseigne-le à des gens en qui tu peux avoir confiance, des gens qui seront capables d’enseigner les autres.

decisions.choice: through many witnesses: in the presence of many witnesses
alternatives: through the mediation of many witnesses
decisions.reason: διὰ here most likely means "in the presence of": Paul's teaching was public and confirmed by many.

decisions.choice: a chain of teaching: Paul, Timothy, faithful people, others
decisions.reason: The verb παράθου is the verb of "deposit" (1:14): the gospel is entrusted from one to another.
ἀνθρώποις is the general word for human beings.
Title setting.
The word means human beings in general (m3); Balanced and Readable say "people".
As in 1:2.

The word means human beings (m3). "Personnes" reads naturally with "fidèles" and "capables", which have the same form in both options, so only the noun changes. Balanced and Readable say "personnes" and "gens" with no span, as the English says "people".

source.text: συγκακοπάθησον ὡς καλὸς στρατιώτης Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

en.L: Share in suffering as a good soldier of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus.
en.B: Join with me in suffering, like a good soldier of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.
en.R: Suffer with me, like a good soldier who serves {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.

fr.L: Prends ta part de souffrance comme un bon soldat du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus.
fr.B: Souffre avec moi, comme un bon soldat du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus.
fr.R: Souffre avec moi, comme un bon soldat qui sert le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus.

decisions.reason: The first of three pictures (soldier, athlete, farmer, verses 3-6): each works hard and looks to a reward.
Title setting.

source.text: οὐδεὶς στρατευόμενος ἐμπλέκεται ταῖς τοῦ βίου πραγματείαις, ἵνα τῷ στρατολογήσαντι ἀρέσῃ·

records.literal_gloss: No one serving as a soldier entangles himself in the of life affairs, so that the [one] having enlisted [him] he may please;

en.L: No one serving as a soldier gets entangled in the affairs of everyday life, so that he may please the one who enlisted him.
en.B: No soldier on active duty gets tangled up in civilian affairs; he wants to please the officer who enlisted him.
en.R: A soldier does not get busy with other things in life. He wants to please his commanding officer.

fr.L: Personne qui sert comme soldat ne s’embarrasse des affaires de la vie, afin de plaire à celui qui l’a enrôlé.
fr.B: Aucun soldat en service ne se laisse prendre par les affaires de la vie civile : il veut plaire à l’officier qui l’a enrôlé.
fr.R: Un soldat ne s’occupe pas d’autres choses de la vie. Il veut plaire à son chef.

decisions.reason: Roman soldiers on service were not to engage in trade or farming; their duty was to their commander.

source.text: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ ἀθλῇ τις, οὐ στεφανοῦται ἐὰν μὴ νομίμως ἀθλήσῃ·

records.literal_gloss: If and also competes anyone, not he is crowned unless lawfully he competes;

en.L: Also, if anyone competes as an athlete, he is not crowned unless he competes according to the rules.
en.B: In the same way, an athlete does not receive the winner's crown unless he competes by the rules.
en.R: An athlete does not win the prize unless he obeys the rules of the game.

fr.L: Et aussi, si quelqu’un concourt comme athlète, il n’est pas couronné s’il ne concourt pas selon les règles.
fr.B: De même, l’athlète ne reçoit la couronne du vainqueur que s’il a lutté selon les règles.
fr.R: Un athlète ne gagne pas le prix s’il ne respecte pas les règles du jeu.

decisions.reason: In the games the winner received a wreath; athletes had to keep the rules, including training, to qualify (1 Corinthians 9:24-27).

source.text: τὸν κοπιῶντα γεωργὸν δεῖ πρῶτον τῶν καρπῶν μεταλαμβάνειν.

records.literal_gloss: The laboring farmer it is necessary first of the fruits to share.

en.L: The hardworking farmer ought to be the first to share in the crops.
en.B: The farmer who does the hard work should be the first to eat from the harvest.
en.R: A farmer who works hard should be the first to eat some of the food he grows.

fr.L: Le cultivateur qui peine doit être le premier à avoir part aux fruits.
fr.B: Le cultivateur qui fait le dur travail doit être le premier à manger de la récolte.
fr.R: Un paysan qui travaille dur doit être le premier à manger une partie de ce qu’il cultive.

decisions.choice: the hardworking farmer shares first in the crops
decisions.reason: Hard work brings its reward. Paul uses the same picture for the support of those who work in the gospel (1 Corinthians 9:7, 9:10).

source.text: νόει ὃ λέγω· δώσει γάρ σοι ὁ κύριος σύνεσιν ἐν πᾶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: Consider what I say; will give for to you the Lord understanding in all things.

en.L: Think about what I am saying, for the Lord will give you understanding in everything.
en.B: Reflect on what I am saying, for the Lord will give you understanding in all things.
en.R: Think about what I am telling you. The Lord will help you understand everything.

fr.L: Réfléchis à ce que je dis, car le Seigneur te donnera l’intelligence en toutes choses.
fr.B: Médite ce que je te dis, car le Seigneur te donnera de comprendre toutes choses.
fr.R: Réfléchis à ce que je te dis. Le Seigneur t’aidera à tout comprendre.

decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read the wish "may the Lord give". The SBLGNT has the future "will give".

source.text: Μνημόνευε Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐγηγερμένον ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐκ σπέρματος Δαυίδ, κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν μου·

records.literal_gloss: Remember Jesus Christ having been raised from [the] dead, of [the] seed of David, according to the gospel of me;

en.L: Remember Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, raised from the dead, a descendant of David, according to my gospel.
en.B: Remember Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, raised from the dead and descended from David, as my gospel proclaims.
en.R: Remember Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. God raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from the dead, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was born into King David's family. That is the good news I tell people.

fr.L: Souviens-toi de Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, ressuscité d’entre les morts, de la descendance de David, selon mon Évangile.
fr.B: Souviens-toi de Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, ressuscité d’entre les morts et descendant de David, comme l’annonce mon Évangile.
fr.R: Souviens-toi de Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité d’entre les morts, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est né dans la famille du roi David. Voilà la bonne nouvelle que j’annonce aux gens.

decisions.choice: raised from the dead: the perfect, raised and still living
decisions.reason: ἐγηγερμένον is perfect: Christ was raised and remains alive.

decisions.choice: of the seed of David: the promised king
decisions.reason: God promised David a descendant who would reign for ever (2 Samuel 7:12-16; Romans 1:3).

decisions.choice: my gospel: the gospel I preach
decisions.reason: Not a different gospel, but the one entrusted to Paul (Romans 2:16).
Title setting.

source.text: ἐν ᾧ κακοπαθῶ μέχρι δεσμῶν ὡς κακοῦργος.

records.literal_gloss: for which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal.

en.L: For [this gospel] I suffer hardship, even to the point of being chained like a criminal.
en.B: For this gospel I am suffering, even to the point of being chained like a criminal.
en.R: Because of this good news I am suffering. I am even chained up in prison, as if I were a criminal.

fr.L: Pour [cet Évangile] je souffre, jusqu’à être enchaîné comme un malfaiteur.
fr.B: Pour cet Évangile, je souffre jusqu’à être enchaîné comme un criminel.
fr.R: À cause de cette bonne nouvelle, je souffre. On m’a même enchaîné en prison, comme si j’étais un criminel.

decisions.reason: κακοῦργος is a wrongdoer, the word used of the criminals crucified with Jesus (Luke 23:32-33).

source.text: ἀλλὰ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ οὐ δέδεται·

records.literal_gloss: but the word of the God not has been bound;

en.L: But the word of God is not chained.
en.B: But God's word is not chained.
en.R: But no one can chain up God's message.

fr.L: Mais la parole de Dieu n’est pas enchaînée.
fr.B: Mais la parole de Dieu, elle, n’est pas enchaînée.
fr.R: Mais personne ne peut enchaîner le message de Dieu.

decisions.choice: the word of God is not chained
decisions.reason: δέδεται is the verb for binding Paul: the messenger is bound, but the message goes on (Philippians 1:12-14).

source.text: διὰ τοῦτο πάντα ὑπομένω διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς, ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ σωτηρίας τύχωσιν τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ μετὰ δόξης αἰωνίου.

records.literal_gloss: Because of this all things I endure because of the chosen, so that also they salvation may obtain the [one] in Christ Jesus with glory eternal.

en.L: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the chosen, so that they also may obtain the salvation that is in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus, with eternal glory.
en.B: So I endure everything for the sake of God's chosen people, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, and with it eternal glory.
en.R: So I am willing to go through anything for the people God has chosen. I want them to be saved by {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus and to share in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eternal glory.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi j’endure tout à cause des élus, afin qu’eux aussi obtiennent le salut qui est {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus, avec une gloire éternelle.
fr.B: Ainsi, j’endure tout pour le peuple que Dieu a choisi, afin qu’eux aussi obtiennent le salut qui est {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus, et avec lui la gloire éternelle.
fr.R: Je suis donc prêt à tout supporter pour ceux que Dieu a choisis. Je veux qu’ils soient sauvés par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus et qu’ils aient part à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire éternelle.

decisions.choice: the chosen: God's people, including those not yet believing
decisions.reason: ἐκλεκτούς are those God has chosen (Titus 1:1). Paul endures so that they may come to salvation.
Title setting.

source.text: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος· εἰ γὰρ συναπεθάνομεν, καὶ συζήσομεν·

records.literal_gloss: Trustworthy [is] the saying: if for we died with [him], also we will live with [him];

en.L: The saying [is] trustworthy: For if we died with [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}], we will also live with [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}].
en.B: Here is a saying you can rely on: If we died with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, we will also live with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Here is something true: If we died with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, we will also live with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Parole digne de foi : car si nous sommes morts avec [{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}], nous vivrons aussi avec [{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}].
fr.B: Voici une parole sûre : si nous sommes morts avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, nous vivrons aussi avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Voici une chose vraie : si nous sommes morts avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, nous vivrons aussi avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

decisions.choice: a trustworthy saying: perhaps an early hymn
decisions.reason: Verses 11-13 have four balanced "if" lines, like a hymn or confession the churches knew.

decisions.choice: if we died with him: in baptism and faith
decisions.reason: Believers share Christ's death and so his life (Romans 6:3-8).
The compound verbs ("die with", "live with") imply "him".
Readable names Christ.

decisions.choice: "Parole digne de foi :" (L); "Voici une parole sûre :" (B)
decisions.reason: French can set the Greek's verbless phrase at the head of the saying without a supplied verb, so Literal needs no brackets; Balanced introduces the saying as the English does.

source.text: εἰ ὑπομένομεν, καὶ συμβασιλεύσομεν· εἰ ἀρνησόμεθα, κἀκεῖνος ἀρνήσεται ἡμᾶς·

records.literal_gloss: if we endure, also we will reign with [him]; if we will deny, also that one will deny us;

en.L: If we endure, we will also reign with [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}]; if we deny [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}], {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also will deny us.
en.B: If we endure, we will also reign with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. If we deny {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will also deny us.
en.R: If we keep going when we suffer, we will rule with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. If we say we do not know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will say that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does not know us.

fr.L: Si nous endurons, nous régnerons aussi avec [{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] ; si nous [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}] renions, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussi nous reniera.
fr.B: Si nous persévérons, nous régnerons aussi avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Si nous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} renions, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussi nous reniera.
fr.R: Si nous tenons bon quand nous souffrons, nous régnerons avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Si nous disons que nous ne {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaissons pas, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dira qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne nous connaît pas.

decisions.choice: if we deny him, he will deny us: the words of Jesus
decisions.reason: "Whoever denies me before others, I will also deny before my Father in heaven" (Matthew 10:33).

source.text: εἰ ἀπιστοῦμεν, ἐκεῖνος πιστὸς μένει· ἀρνήσασθαι ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται.

records.literal_gloss: if we are faithless, that one faithful remains; to deny himself not he is able.

en.L: If we are faithless, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remains faithful, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cannot deny {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}.
en.B: If we are unfaithful, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remains faithful, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cannot be false to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}.
en.R: If we are not faithful, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is still faithful, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cannot go against who {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is.

fr.L: Si nous sommes infidèles, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demeure fidèle, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne peut se renier {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}.
fr.B: Si nous manquons de fidélité, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} reste fidèle, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne peut pas se trahir {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}.
fr.R: Si nous ne sommes pas fidèles, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} reste fidèle, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne peut pas aller contre ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est.

decisions.choice: if we are faithless, he remains faithful
alternatives: a warning: he will be faithful to his word to judge
decisions.reason: The fourth line breaks the pattern: Christ's faithfulness does not depend on ours. Most read it as assurance; some as a warning that he stays true to his word, including verse 12. Either way he "cannot deny himself".
ἀπιστέω means to be unfaithful or not to believe.

source.text: Ταῦτα ὑπομίμνῃσκε, διαμαρτυρόμενος ἐνώπιον τοῦ κυρίου, μὴ λογομαχεῖν, ἐπ’ οὐδὲν χρήσιμον, ἐπὶ καταστροφῇ τῶν ἀκουόντων.

records.literal_gloss: These things remind [them], charging before the Lord not to fight about words, for nothing useful, to the ruin of those hearing.

en.L: Remind [them] of these things, solemnly charging [them] before the Lord not to quarrel about words, which is of no use and ruins those who listen.
en.B: Keep reminding people of these things, and warn them before the Lord not to quarrel about words. It does no good and only ruins those who listen.
en.R: Keep reminding the believers of these things. Warn them, in front of the Lord, not to argue about words. Arguments like that do no good. They only hurt the people who listen.

fr.L: Rappelle-[leur] ces choses, en [les] adjurant devant le Seigneur de ne pas se quereller sur des mots, ce qui ne sert à rien et cause la ruine de ceux qui écoutent.
fr.B: Continue de rappeler ces choses aux gens, et avertis-les devant le Seigneur de ne pas se quereller sur des mots. Cela ne sert à rien, sinon à ruiner ceux qui écoutent.
fr.R: Continue de rappeler ces choses aux croyants. Avertis-les, devant le Seigneur, de ne pas se disputer sur des mots. Ce genre de dispute ne sert à rien. Il fait seulement du mal à ceux qui écoutent.

decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "God".
καταστροφῇ is overturning, the root of "catastrophe".

source.text: σπούδασον σεαυτὸν δόκιμον παραστῆσαι τῷ θεῷ, ἐργάτην ἀνεπαίσχυντον, ὀρθοτομοῦντα τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας.

records.literal_gloss: Be eager yourself approved to present to the God, a worker not ashamed, rightly cutting the word of the truth.

en.L: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth.
en.B: Make every effort to stand before God tested and approved, a worker with nothing to be ashamed of, who handles the message of truth correctly.
en.R: Work hard so that God will be pleased with you. Be a worker who does not need to be ashamed, and teach God's true message the right way.

fr.L: Efforce-toi de te présenter à Dieu approuvé, ouvrier qui n’a pas à avoir honte, traçant droit la parole de la vérité.
fr.B: Fais tout ton possible pour te présenter devant Dieu éprouvé et approuvé, comme un ouvrier qui n’a rien dont il doive avoir honte et qui transmet correctement le message de la vérité.
fr.R: Travaille dur pour que Dieu soit content de toi. Sois un ouvrier qui n’a pas besoin d’avoir honte, et enseigne de la bonne manière le vrai message de Dieu.

decisions.choice: do your best: be eager, make every effort
decisions.reason: σπουδάζω is to hurry, to be eager.
ὀρθοτομέω means to cut straight, as a road is cut straight or a stonemason cuts true. Timothy is to teach the word without twisting it.
"Message" is plainer than "word" here; the key term "truth" stays.
The verb pictures cutting a straight line (m2); "tracer droit" keeps that picture in plain French, as a road or furrow is traced straight. Balanced says what it means for the message.

source.text: τὰς δὲ βεβήλους κενοφωνίας περιΐστασο· ἐπὶ πλεῖον γὰρ προκόψουσιν ἀσεβείας, καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτῶν ὡς γάγγραινα νομὴν ἕξει· ὧν ἐστιν Ὑμέναιος καὶ Φίλητος, οἵτινες περὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἠστόχησαν, λέγοντες ἀνάστασιν ἤδη γεγονέναι, καὶ ἀνατρέπουσιν τήν τινων πίστιν.

records.literal_gloss: The but profane empty chatter avoid; to more for they will advance of ungodliness, \v 17 and the word of them like gangrene pasture will have; of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus, \v 18 who concerning the truth have missed the mark, saying [the] resurrection already to have happened, and they overturn the of some faith.

en.L: But avoid irreverent, empty chatter, for they will go on to more ungodliness, \v 17 and their talk will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus, \v 18 who have swerved from the truth, saying that the resurrection has already happened, and they are overturning the faith of some.
en.B: Stay away from godless, empty chatter, because those who indulge in it will become more and more ungodly, \v 17 and their teaching will spread like gangrene. Hymenaeus and Philetus are among them. \v 18 They have wandered away from the truth, saying that the resurrection has already taken place, and they are destroying the faith of some.
en.R: Stay away from people who talk about foolish things that have nothing to do with God. That kind of talk makes people turn further away from God. \v 17 Their teaching spreads like a disease that eats away the body. Hymenaeus and Philetus are two of these people. \v 18 They have turned away from the truth. They say that the dead have already been raised to new life. They are destroying some people's faith.

fr.L: Mais évite les bavardages vides et profanes, car ils iront toujours plus loin dans l’impiété, \v 17 et leur parole se répandra comme la gangrène. Parmi eux sont Hyménée et Philète, \v 18 qui se sont écartés de la vérité, disant que la résurrection a déjà eu lieu, et ils renversent la foi de quelques-uns.
fr.B: Tiens-toi à l’écart des bavardages vides et sans Dieu, car ceux qui s’y livrent tomberont toujours plus dans l’impiété, \v 17 et leur enseignement se répandra comme la gangrène. Hyménée et Philète sont de ceux-là. \v 18 Ils se sont égarés loin de la vérité en disant que la résurrection a déjà eu lieu, et ils détruisent la foi de certains.
fr.R: Tiens-toi loin des gens qui parlent de choses absurdes, qui n’ont rien à voir avec Dieu. Ce genre de discours éloigne encore plus les gens de Dieu. \v 17 Leur enseignement se répand comme une maladie qui ronge le corps. Hyménée et Philète font partie de ces gens. \v 18 Ils se sont détournés de la vérité. Ils disent que les morts sont déjà ressuscités pour une vie nouvelle. Ils détruisent la foi de certaines personnes.

decisions.choice: they will advance: those who talk this way
decisions.reason: προκόψουσιν is plural and most naturally refers to the people who engage in it.
γάγγραινα is a spreading sore that eats away healthy flesh; it is set against "sound" (healthy) teaching (1:13).
They taught that the resurrection was only a present spiritual reality, denying a future bodily resurrection (compare 1 Corinthians 15:12). Hymenaeus is probably the man of 1 Timothy 1:20.

decisions.choice: l’impiété (L, B), and la piété for "godliness" in 3:5 and 3:12 (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Piété" and "impiété" are the established French pair for this word family, which the Pastoral Letters use often. Readable says what it means, as the English does ("turn further away from God").

source.text: ὁ μέντοι στερεὸς θεμέλιος τοῦ θεοῦ ἕστηκεν, ἔχων τὴν σφραγῖδα ταύτην· Ἔγνω κύριος τοὺς ὄντας αὐτοῦ, καί· Ἀποστήτω ἀπὸ ἀδικίας πᾶς ὁ ὀνομάζων τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου.

records.literal_gloss: The nevertheless firm foundation of the God stands, having the seal this: Knew [the] Lord those being his, and: Let depart from unrighteousness everyone naming the name of [the] Lord.

en.L: Nevertheless, God's firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: "[The] Lord knows those who are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}," and, "Let everyone who names the name of [the] Lord depart from unrighteousness."
en.B: But God's solid foundation stands firm, sealed with these words: "The Lord knows those who are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}," and "Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from wickedness."
en.R: But what God has built stands strong, like a building on a solid foundation. It is marked with these words: "The Lord knows who belongs to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}," and "Everyone who says they belong to the Lord must stop doing wrong."

fr.L: Toutefois, le solide fondement de Dieu tient debout, portant ce sceau : « Le Seigneur connaît ceux qui sont à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} », et : « Qu’il s’éloigne de l’injustice, quiconque prononce le nom du Seigneur. »
fr.B: Mais le fondement solide posé par Dieu tient bon, scellé de ces paroles : « Le Seigneur connaît ceux qui sont à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} », et : « Quiconque invoque le nom du Seigneur doit se détourner du mal. »
fr.R: Mais ce que Dieu a construit reste solide, comme un bâtiment sur de bonnes fondations. Ces paroles y sont gravées : « Le Seigneur connaît ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent », et : « Tous ceux qui disent qu’ils appartiennent au Seigneur doivent arrêter de faire le mal. »

decisions.choice: the Lord knows those who are his: Numbers 16:5
decisions.reason: When Korah rebelled, Moses said, "The LORD will show who is his" (Numbers 16:5, in its Greek form). God knows his own, whatever false teachers claim.

decisions.choice: let everyone who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness
decisions.reason: The words echo Numbers 16:26 ("depart from the tents of these wicked men") and Isaiah 26:13 and 52:11. Belonging to the Lord means leaving evil.

decisions.choice: seal: an inscription on a foundation stone
decisions.reason: Foundation stones sometimes bore inscriptions; a seal also marked ownership. God's foundation, his church or his truth, bears two marks.

source.text: Ἐν μεγάλῃ δὲ οἰκίᾳ οὐκ ἔστιν μόνον σκεύη χρυσᾶ καὶ ἀργυρᾶ ἀλλὰ καὶ ξύλινα καὶ ὀστράκινα, καὶ ἃ μὲν εἰς τιμὴν ἃ δὲ εἰς ἀτιμίαν·

records.literal_gloss: In a great but house not there are only vessels gold and silver but also wooden and earthen, and some for honor, some but for dishonor;

en.L: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and silver but also of wood and clay, some for honorable use and some for dishonorable.
en.B: In a large house there are not only gold and silver dishes but also wooden and clay ones, some for special occasions and some for common use.
en.R: A big house has dishes made of gold and silver, but it also has dishes made of wood and clay. Some are used for special purposes, and some are used for ordinary things.

fr.L: Or, dans une grande maison, il n’y a pas seulement des vases d’or et d’argent, mais aussi de bois et de terre, les uns pour un usage honorable, les autres pour un usage sans honneur.
fr.B: Dans une grande maison, il n’y a pas seulement de la vaisselle d’or et d’argent, mais aussi de la vaisselle de bois et de terre cuite, certaines pièces pour les grandes occasions, d’autres pour l’usage courant.
fr.R: Dans une grande maison, il y a de la vaisselle en or et en argent, mais aussi de la vaisselle en bois et en terre. On utilise certains plats pour des occasions spéciales, et d’autres pour les choses de tous les jours.

decisions.choice: vessels for honor and for dishonor: the household picture
decisions.reason: σκεύη is a container or utensil. In a great house some are for fine use and some for common or dirty use. The picture leads to verse 21.

source.text: ἐὰν οὖν τις ἐκκαθάρῃ ἑαυτὸν ἀπὸ τούτων, ἔσται σκεῦος εἰς τιμήν, ἡγιασμένον, εὔχρηστον τῷ δεσπότῃ, εἰς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἡτοιμασμένον.

records.literal_gloss: If therefore anyone cleanses himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, having been sanctified, useful to the master, for every work good having been prepared.

en.L: So if anyone cleanses himself from these things, he will be a vessel for honor, set apart as holy, useful to the master, prepared for every good work.
en.B: Those who keep themselves clean from such things will be vessels for special use, made holy, useful to the master, and ready for every good work.
en.R: If you keep yourself pure from these bad things, you will be like a dish used for special purposes. You will be holy and useful to your Master, ready to do every kind of good work.

fr.L: Si donc quelqu’un se purifie de ces choses, il sera un vase d’honneur, sanctifié, utile au maître, préparé pour toute œuvre bonne.
fr.B: Celui qui se garde pur de tout cela sera un vase réservé aux usages nobles, sanctifié, utile au maître, prêt pour toute œuvre bonne.
fr.R: Si tu te gardes pur de ces mauvaises choses, tu seras comme un plat qui sert pour des occasions spéciales. Tu seras saint et utile à ton Maître, prêt à faire toutes sortes de bonnes actions.

decisions.choice: from these: from the dishonorable vessels, the false teachers and their ways
decisions.reason: τούτων most likely refers back to the "vessels for dishonor" and to the false teaching of verses 16-18.

decisions.choice: the master: the owner of the house, God
decisions.reason: δεσπότῃ is the master of the house; in the picture, the Lord.
The Greek "anyone" includes women; Balanced and Readable avoid "himself".
The English Balanced uses a plural to avoid "himself"; French "celui qui" already means anyone, man or woman (style guide §7), so Balanced keeps the Greek singular.

source.text: τὰς δὲ νεωτερικὰς ἐπιθυμίας φεῦγε, δίωκε δὲ δικαιοσύνην, πίστιν, ἀγάπην, εἰρήνην μετὰ τῶν ἐπικαλουμένων τὸν κύριον ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας.

records.literal_gloss: The but youthful desires flee, pursue but righteousness, faith, love, peace with those calling on the Lord out of a pure heart.

en.L: So flee youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love [and] peace, along with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
en.B: Run away from the passions of youth, and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace, together with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
en.R: Run away from the wrong desires that young people often have. Instead, try hard to live a righteous life, and to have faith, love and peace. Do this together with people who pray to the Lord with pure hearts.

fr.L: Fuis donc les passions de la jeunesse, et poursuis la justice, la foi, l’amour, la paix, avec ceux qui invoquent le Seigneur d’un cœur pur.
fr.B: Fuis les passions propres à la jeunesse ; recherche plutôt la justice, la foi, l’amour et la paix, avec tous ceux qui, d’un cœur pur, font appel au Seigneur.
fr.R: Fuis les mauvais désirs que les jeunes ont souvent. Au contraire, fais tout pour vivre d’une manière juste, et pour avoir la foi, l’amour et la paix. Fais-le avec ceux qui prient le Seigneur avec un cœur pur.

decisions.choice: youthful passions: the desires of youth
decisions.reason: νεωτερικὰς covers not only sexual desire but impatience, love of argument and ambition, which fit the context (verse 23).

decisions.choice: those who call on the Lord: believers
decisions.reason: A biblical phrase for God's people (Joel 2:32; Romans 10:13).

source.text: τὰς δὲ μωρὰς καὶ ἀπαιδεύτους ζητήσεις παραιτοῦ, εἰδὼς ὅτι γεννῶσι μάχας·

records.literal_gloss: The but foolish and ignorant controversies refuse, knowing that they produce quarrels;

en.L: Refuse foolish and ignorant controversies, knowing that they breed quarrels.
en.B: Have nothing to do with foolish and ignorant arguments; you know they only lead to quarrels.
en.R: Stay away from foolish and stupid arguments. You know that they only start fights.

fr.L: Refuse les controverses folles et ignorantes, sachant qu’elles engendrent des querelles.
fr.B: N’aie rien à faire avec les discussions folles et ignorantes : tu sais qu’elles ne mènent qu’à des querelles.
fr.R: Tiens-toi loin des discussions bêtes et stupides. Tu sais qu’elles ne font que provoquer des disputes.

decisions.reason: ἀπαιδεύτους is untrained, unschooled: arguments with no grounding in sound teaching.

source.text: δοῦλον δὲ κυρίου οὐ δεῖ μάχεσθαι, ἀλλὰ ἤπιον εἶναι πρὸς πάντας, διδακτικόν, ἀνεξίκακον, ἐν πραΰτητι παιδεύοντα τοὺς ἀντιδιατιθεμένους, μήποτε δώῃ αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς μετάνοιαν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας, καὶ ἀνανήψωσιν ἐκ τῆς τοῦ διαβόλου παγίδος, ἐζωγρημένοι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἐκείνου θέλημα.

records.literal_gloss: A slave but of [the] Lord not must quarrel, but gentle be toward all, able to teach, patient under wrong, \v 25 in gentleness correcting those opposing, if perhaps may give them the God repentance unto knowledge of truth, \v 26 and they may come to their senses out of the of the devil snare, having been captured by him for the of that one will.

en.L: And the Lord's slave must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient when wronged, \v 25 correcting opponents with gentleness. Perhaps God may grant them repentance leading to knowledge of [the] truth, \v 26 and they may come to their senses [and escape] from the snare of the devil, having been captured by him to do his will.
en.B: The Lord's servant must not be quarrelsome but kind to everyone, able to teach and patient with difficult people, \v 25 gently correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God will grant them repentance and they will come to know the truth, \v 26 and come to their senses and escape the trap of the devil, who has held them captive to do his will.
en.R: A servant of the Lord must not fight. They must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and patient when people treat them badly. \v 25 They must gently correct people who are against them. Maybe God will help those people turn away from their sins and know the truth. \v 26 Then they will think clearly again. They will escape from the devil's trap, the trap he used to catch them so that they would do what he wants.

fr.L: Or l’esclave du Seigneur ne doit pas se quereller, mais être doux envers tous, capable d’enseigner, patient quand on lui fait du tort, \v 25 corrigeant avec douceur les opposants. Peut-être Dieu leur donnera-t-il la repentance pour la connaissance de la vérité, \v 26 et ils se ressaisiront [en s’échappant] du piège du diable, ayant été capturés par lui pour [faire] sa volonté.
fr.B: Le serviteur du Seigneur ne doit pas aimer les querelles, mais être bienveillant envers tous, capable d’enseigner et patient avec les gens difficiles, \v 25 corrigeant avec douceur ceux qui s’opposent à lui. Peut-être Dieu leur accordera-t-il de se repentir et de parvenir à connaître la vérité, \v 26 de revenir à la raison et d’échapper au piège du diable, qui les tient captifs pour leur faire faire sa volonté.
fr.R: Un serviteur du Seigneur ne doit pas se battre. Il doit être bon avec tout le monde, capable d’enseigner, et patient quand on le traite mal. \v 25 Il doit corriger avec douceur ceux qui sont contre lui. Peut-être que Dieu aidera ces gens à se détourner de leurs péchés et à connaître la vérité. \v 26 Alors ils retrouveront leur bon sens. Ils échapperont au piège du diable, le piège qu’il a utilisé pour les attraper et leur faire faire ce qu’il veut.

decisions.choice: the Lord's slave: one who belongs to the Lord and serves him
decisions.reason: δοῦλον is the word for a slave, a title Paul uses of himself (Titus 1:1; Philippians 1:1).

decisions.choice: captured by him to do his will: by the devil, for the devil's will
alternatives: captured by the Lord's slave, to do God's will
captured by the devil, and now to do God's will
decisions.reason: Two different pronouns are used, αὐτοῦ ("him") and ἐκείνου ("that one"), which may refer to different persons. Most naturally both refer to the devil, just named; but ἐκείνου may point back to God (verse 25), so that they escape the devil to do God's will, or αὐτοῦ to the Lord's slave who wins them back.
Repentance is God's gift; the teacher's part is gentle correction.
"Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that the person was owned, and Literal keeps "slave".
Readable uses "they", since any of the Lord's servants is meant.

decisions.choice: la repentance (L), se repentir (B); se détourner de leurs péchés (R) (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The terms of the French New Testament (style guide §9); Readable follows the English "turn away from their sins".

The English Readable uses "they" so that any servant of the Lord is meant. In French the generic "il" after "un serviteur" is ordinary and already includes women (style guide §7), so Readable keeps it rather than changing the number.
